Owner-entered Notion selections retain Production and Ongoing maintenance; Internal use is added as the specific confirmed use context. Public npm 1.0.0 was published on 25 March 2026; public GitHub main is 3416fa67. Local HEAD 90f64285 adds symbol renaming on 17 April 2026. Start/end dates describe the observed Git development window (25 March–17 April 2026), accepted by the owner; End Date is not a retirement or use-end date. Filesystem metadata corroborates March/April 2026. The 2025 changelog year conflicts with Git/npm and is not used.
projects.outcomeEvidence:
Owner-reported qualitative result on 17 November 2026: ts-shove is in active use and makes TypeScript file moves much easier for the owner’s agents through AST-based batch moves and customizable import handling. No time-saving percentage, external user count or business-impact baseline was provided. Independently run local functional checks: 254 existing regression tests passed across library and scoped CLI runs. The README AI-attributed 300+ file / 15 batch / 860-test testimonial remains excluded from measured outcomes.

Owner clarification, 18 November 2026: considers ts-shove probably the most-used of the recently added projects. This is a qualitative comparison, not a measured invocation count or external adoption metric.
